name: Look At Me
body:
Your stare transfixes your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Stare focus, ability to cast lock gaze, character level 9

Benefit(s): Whenever you cast a spell or use transfix on at least one creature, you may cast lock gaze on one of the targets as part of the same action. Lock gaze applies first.
